categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Mobitech Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing sector, focusing on automotive sunroofs and other automotive sport components. The company offers integrated design, research, development, and production capabilities for panoramic sunroofs, small sunroofs, electric tail wings, door modules, and related automotive components. It serves well-known domestic and some overseas automobile manufacturers, providing complete automotive sunroof and sport component solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automotive sunroof design and manufacturing technologies, including integrated light, mechanical, and electrical systems. It emphasizes high precision in dimensions, rigorous performance testing under extreme conditions, and health-conscious materials such as low-VOC coatings and negative oxygen ion fabrics. Production follows a 'make-to-order' model with strict quality control, virtual development simulation, and intelligent data sharing across procurement and manufacturing. R&D focuses on lightweight, ultra-thin, modular, healthy, and intelligent sunroof systems, including innovations like adjustable PDLC glass, micro backup power supplies, and integrated control ECUs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Mobitech's key customers are major domestic automotive manufacturers including Changan, FAW Group, Geely, GAC Group, SAIC Volkswagen, Great Wall Motors, and Chery, as well as emerging new energy vehicle brands like GAC Aion, Hozon Auto, Leapmotor, Jidu Auto, BAIC New Energy, Lantu, and Hozon. The company primarily serves the automotive manufacturing industry, focusing on passenger vehicles and new energy vehicles within China, with some overseas OEMs as well.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Chengdu, Xiangtan, Huzhou, Tianjin, Jilin, and Wuhu. Domestic sales account for over 97% of revenue, with a small but growing export segment. The company is expanding its market reach domestically into second- and third-tier cities and internationally by engaging with global OEMs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Mobitech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a Tier 1 supplier, directly providing automotive sunroofs and sport components to OEMs. It procures raw materials such as rails, motors, glass, and ECUs from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components downstream to vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven development with a strong R&D team of approximately 160 personnel. Strategic R&D directions include lightweight and ultra-thin sunroofs, modular designs, health-oriented materials like negative oxygen ion fabrics, intelligent and automated sunroof control systems, and expansion into new product lines such as electric tail wings, door modules, charging port covers, retractable radars, and liftable speakers. It also focuses on integrating smart connectivity and enhancing product reliability and cost competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Mobitech generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive sunroof products and related automotive sport components to OEMs under supply agreements. The company also earns income from mold development contracts and other automotive component sales. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance, with no significant reliance on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: According to industry research, Mobitech is the second-largest automotive sunroof supplier in China with a 16% market share as of 2023. It is the only top-five Chinese sunroof supplier originating domestically. The company competes with both domestic and international automotive parts manufacturers, leveraging its strong R&D, quality certifications, and stable relationships with major OEMs to maintain a leading position in the automotive sunroof market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Mobitech reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.41 billion, a slight decrease of 3.35% from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 6.98% to about RMB 171 million. The company maintains a solid asset base of RMB 2.26 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 817 million, reflecting a 27.56% increase year-over-year. Despite a decline in cash flow from operations, the company continues to invest in new plant construction and R&D, indicating a growth-oriented profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mobitech emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced automotive sunroofs that meet stringent performance, dimensional precision, and health standards. Its products integrate light, mechanical, and electrical functions with innovations such as negative oxygen ion releasing fabrics, ultra-thin shading curtains, and intelligent control systems. The company’s comprehensive in-house R&D, extensive testing capabilities, and strong OEM certifications differentiate it by offering customized, reliable, and innovative sunroof solutions that enhance vehicle comfort, safety, and aesthetics.
